papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein interacts with stress-granule proteins including G3BP1 and undergoes phase separation, sequestering the G3BP scaffold to modulate stress-granule assembly.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein interacts with immunoregulators and stress granules and phase separates to form liquid droplets.

papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 N protein phase-separates with G3BP1/G3BP2, disassembling host stress granules by co-condensing the G3BP scaffold away from stress-granule seeds.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid protein phase separates with G3BPs to disassemble stress granules and facilitate viral production.

papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 N protein antagonizes stress-granule assembly through its interaction with G3BP1, suppressing the stress-granule-associated interferon response.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 N Protein Antagonizes Stress Granule Assembly and IFN Production by Interacting with G3BPs to Facilitate Viral Replication.

papers.one_line_mechanism: SARS-CoV-2 N protein recruits G3BP to double-membrane vesicles at viral replication sites, relocalizing the stress-granule scaffold to promote replication.
papers.title: SARS-CoV-2 N protein recruits G3BP to double membrane vesicles to promote translation of viral mRNAs.

papers.one_line_mechanism: Betacoronavirus nucleocapsid proteins convergently evolved an ITFG (ΦxFG-like) G3BP1-binding motif that mediates the N–G3BP1 interaction and stress-granule antagonism.
papers.title: Convergent evolution of the G3BP1-binding motif in betacoronavirus nucleocapsid proteins.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: G3BP1 acts as a tunable molecular switch whose RNA-dependent conformational change triggers liquid–liquid phase separation to nucleate stress granules, with G3BP2 acting redundantly.
neighbor_papers.title: G3BP1 Is a Tunable Switch that Triggers Phase Separation to Assemble Stress Granules.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: RNA-induced conformational switching and clustering of the G3BP1/G3BP2 dimer drives stress-granule condensation via a protein–RNA percolation network.
neighbor_papers.title: RNA-Induced Conformational Switching and Clustering of G3BP Drive Stress Granule Assembly by Condensation.

neighbor_papers.one_line_mechanism: Competing protein–RNA interaction networks centered on G3BP1/G3BP2 control multiphase stress-granule organization, defining G3BP as the central assembly node.
neighbor_papers.title: Competing Protein-RNA Interaction Networks Control Multiphase Intracellular Organization.
